transformations.proof: D, A read directly off the graph's edge set; L = D - A by definition.
numpy.linalg.eigh (symmetric solver) cross-checked against sympy exact characteristic-polynomial eigenvalues for n<=8.
scipy.linalg.expm; eigen-action R(t)phi_n = e^{-t lambda_n} phi_n verified to <1e-6 residual on every swept case.
hypotheses checked numerically per case; residual ||e^{-tL}-P_ker(L)|| probed at t scaled to 1/spectral_gap and confirmed < 1e-6.
direct evaluation of the diffusion-map distance formula.

equations.derivation: D_ii := sum_j A_ij by definition, so (L@1)_i = D_ii - sum_j A_ij = 0 for every i; proved symbolically (sympy) for a generic 5x5 symmetric zero-diagonal adjacency matrix, not merely observed on one numeric example.
follows from L phi_n = lambda_n phi_n and R(t) = e^{-tL} via the spectral theorem for symmetric operators; verified numerically (not re-derived symbolically) across every swept topology/size.
